summary: All 8 acceptance criteria exercised via 9 browser checks (1 criterion double-covered via public preview URL as required). No backend test files added: the app is explicitly 100% client-side (localStorage only); the only backend endpoint is the unchanged template /api/status, which is not part of any acceptance criterion.

checks.name: start-screen-and-play
checks.evidence: start-game-button visible on load; after click main-arrow-box and timer-progress-bar visible

checks.name: normal-arrow-correct-move-scores
checks.evidence: Read data-dir/data-reversed=false from main-arrow-box, dragged >30px in that direction, current-score-display became '1'

checks.name: reverse-arrow-opposite-move-scores
checks.evidence: Looped correct moves until data-reversed=true appeared, swiped opposite direction, score incremented by 1

checks.name: wrong-direction-ends-game
checks.evidence: game-over-modal visible with text 'Wrong direction', final-score-value and game-over-best-score present

checks.name: timeout-ends-game
checks.evidence: No move made at score 0; game-over-modal appeared within 4s containing 'Time'

checks.name: preview-arrows-shift-after-move
checks.evidence: preview-arrow-1/2 (.last() to skip 200ms-stale exiting duplicates) visible and smaller than main-arrow-box; after correct move main-arrow-box data-dir equals old preview-arrow-1 data-dir

checks.name: best-score-persists-and-play-again
checks.evidence: Cleared ra_best_score, scored 1 then ended game -> new-record-indicator shown, final-score-value=1; play-again-button reset score to 0; localStorage ra_best_score='1' persisted after page.reload()

checks.name: sound-toggle-and-help-dialog
checks.evidence: sound-toggle-button aria-label changed on click, ra_sound_enabled stored; how-to-play-button opened rule-dialog-content
